name: Mahjong Official Rules (MCR)
description: Mahjong Official Rules, often called MCR, is a standardized competition-focused Mahjong ruleset. It keeps classic Mahjong draw-discard structure while using a formalized scoring catalog for consistent tournament adjudication.

overview.description: Mahjong Official Rules, often called MCR, is a standardized competition-focused Mahjong ruleset. It keeps classic Mahjong draw-discard structure while using a formalized scoring catalog for consistent tournament adjudication.

history.origins: This ruleset was assembled to provide a unified modern competition framework for Mahjong while preserving core traditional tile-play mechanics.
timeline: Later: used as a neutral baseline in international rules comparison.
history.cultural: It functions as a formal reference system for structured Mahjong play.
history.evolution: The format prioritizes consistent scoring interpretation and reduced house-rule ambiguity.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honors, and bonus tiles.
setup.dealing: Each player starts with 13 tiles; dealer starts with 14.

rules.objective: Complete a valid 14-tile hand and score under the official scoring catalog.
rules.gameplay: Players take turns drawing one tile and discarding one tile. Discards may be claimed for legal melds by claim priority rules. A hand wins on self-draw or discard claim when structural and scoring requirements are met.
keyRules: Claim rules determine Chow, Pung, and Kong legality and priority.
Winning requires valid hand structure and recognized scoring pattern(s).

strategy.basic: Prefer efficient waits and avoid dead shape commitments.
strategy.intermediate: Track visible tiles to estimate remaining completion routes.
strategy.advanced: Trade speed for value only when risk and tile flow support it.
tips: Protect flexible middle-tile structures in early turns.
Do not overexpose your hand unless value gain is clear.

synthesis.shortDescription: Mahjong Official Rules (MCR) standardizes competition Mahjong while preserving classical draw-discard meld play.
